Changed toolchain/driver/runtimes_cache.h and wrote the reason down in docs/decisions/carbon-handoff-locked-cache-age.md.

Commit message:
The Brightwater build farm's long-lived build daemon holds its runtimes entry locked for up to three weeks; at 10 days a concurrent compile evicted it and every later link failed with missing runtime files until restart.

writes.docs/decisions/carbon-handoff-locked-cac:
# Why toolchain/driver/runtimes_cache.h holds this value

The Brightwater build farm's long-lived build daemon holds its runtimes entry locked for up to three weeks; at 10 days a concurrent compile evicted it and every later link failed with missing runtime files until restart.
